# RAPID part 2 results (generated by rapid/first_success.py)

Test amines with at least one 4-point experiment: 31. Experiments to the first 4 counts the 4-point experiment itself; no 4 within 48 experiments counts as 49. Cells: mean over amines [95% amine bootstrap, 1000]. Random-start strategies averaged over 20 repeats per amine.

## verdict
- 주 판정 (선택된 학습 전략이 무작위·고르게 훑기보다 빠름): **미달**
- 1~3점의 가치 (재학습 점수 1~4 − 재학습 4점 여부 < 0): **미달**
